answer: Anti-sybil: three-beacon presence proof. Each epoch, every bonded agent signs a nonce from three random beacons within 90 seconds and posts all three signatures before close. One operator cannot answer from three places at once, so a gale of fake keys stalls at the first ping. Each identity locks 500 POA; a missed beacon slashes 250 POA and demotes the key to probation. 1000 sybils need 500,000 POA locked plus physical nodes at three coordinates - capital no swarm can fake. Trust lands where the willow bends to the wind, not where a thousand keys shout from one box at zenith.
